zones.name: Kraka Footpath
zones.desc: A hill named after a legendary Tursin Krall chieftain. Also serving as a path to the Drana Plantation and the Balaur Stronghold, its proximity to these locations means there is a significant risk of encountering Balaur minions.

zones.name: Kraka Footpath
zones.desc: A hill named after a legendary Tursin Krall chieftain. Also serving as a path to the Drana Plantation and the Balaur Stronghold, its proximity to these locations means there is a significant risk of encountering Balaur minions.

zones.name: Eastern Cantas Valley
zones.desc: The eastern region of the Cantas Valley. Groups of refugees attempting to flee to the Dawn Legion often pass through. The area is relatively dangerous due to the lack of Dawn Legion presence.

zones.name: Eastern Cantas Valley
zones.desc: The eastern region of the Cantas Valley. Groups of refugees attempting to flee to the Dawn Legion often pass through. The area is relatively dangerous due to the lack of Dawn Legion presence.

zones.name: Western Cantas Valley
zones.desc: The western region of the Cantas Valley. Since Odylium was discovered here and a number of collectors were installed, it has long served as a key source of Odylium for the Daeva for some time. The Dawn Legion has repaired the collectors and is gathering the scarce Odyle.

zones.name: Collapsed Verteron Barrier Tower
zones.desc: Together with Spiritmasters, the Dawn Legion has established a base to facilitate the restoration of the Verteron Barrier Tower after it was shattered in an attack by the Ishtar Brigade.

zones.name: Contaminated Marsh
zones.desc: A contaminated marsh downstream of the Ellun River flowing through Verteron, now uninhabitable due to the wastewater from the Balaur's Drana Plantation.

zones.name: Anguish Hill
zones.desc: A hilly area along the middle stretches of Ellun River. Daeva who scattered across Verteron following various defeats against the Balaur rallied together, seeking a chance to strike back. Ultimately, they perished without ever even crossing these hills.

zones.name: Anguish Hill
zones.desc: A hilly area along the middle stretches of Ellun River. Daeva who scattered across Verteron following various defeats against the Balaur rallied together, seeking a chance to strike back. Ultimately, they perished without ever even crossing these hills.

zones.name: Dundu's Rest
zones.desc:
A small base of the Wind Breeze Merchants near the Verteron Fortress Ruins.
Rumor has it that a Shugo named Dundu also trades with the Krall.

zones.name: Ellun River Meadow
zones.desc: A grassland located between the Eastern Cantas Valley and the Ellun River Marsh. The area still remains unpolluted and pristine.

zones.name: Ellun River Midstream
zones.desc: The middle stretches of the Ellun River, which flows through Verteron. It has a relatively clean environment.

zones.name: Ellun River Midstream
zones.desc: The middle stretches of the Ellun River, which flows through Verteron. It has a relatively clean environment.

zones.name: Ellun River Midstream
zones.desc: The middle stretches of the Ellun River, which flows through Verteron. It has a relatively clean environment.

zones.name: Ellun River Midstream
zones.desc: The middle stretches of the Ellun River, which flows through Verteron. It has a relatively clean environment.

zones.name: Pamos Farm
zones.desc: A farm along the Ellun River Midstream. Despite its appearance as a peaceful and ordinary farm, its owner, Pamos, is involved in shady dealings with marauders.

zones.name: Destroyed Abyss Gate
zones.desc: An Abyss Gate once located above Verteron Fortress. When the Fortress fell, the gate was also attacked and destroyed. An Abyss Rift appeared for a time afterward, but has now subsided. Klaw from the Abyss Rift have settled in the area.

zones.name: Verteron Fortress Ruins
zones.desc: A fortress that served as an Abyss Gate and repelled invaders into Verteron. It was destroyed and rebuilt many times during the long war with the Balaur, but was eventually abandoned altogether once Daeva had grown too thin. It is now garrisoned and managed by Krall.

zones.name: Verteron Fortress Ruins
zones.desc: A fortress that served as an Abyss Gate and repelled invaders into Verteron. It was destroyed and rebuilt many times during the long war with the Balaur, but was eventually abandoned altogether once Daeva had grown too thin. It is now garrisoned and managed by Krall.

zones.name: Northern Tolbas Forest
zones.desc: The northern part of Tolbas Forest, adjacent to the Verteron Fortress Ruins. Dangerous animals and plants can be found here.

zones.name: Southern Tolbas Forest
zones.desc: The southern part of Tolbas Forest, and a popular hiding place for bandits and marauders.

zones.name: Southern Tolbas Forest
zones.desc: The southern part of Tolbas Forest, and a popular hiding place for bandits and marauders.

zones.name: Eastern Tolbas Forest
zones.desc: The border between the Tolbas Forest and the Aullaeu Village. It is the site of a war of nerves between the Shugo of Wind Breeze Merchants and the Urugugu tribe of Aullaeu.

zones.name: Night Dew Cave
zones.desc: A small, hidden cave in Tolbas Forest. Originally used by the Wind Breeze Merchants as an office and storage place for old documents, they were forced to abandon it as the Aullaeu's local influence grow. It is now maintained only for Kochi's personal use.

zones.name: Aullaeu Village
zones.desc: This is a settlement of the Urugugu tribe, an Aullaeu people who followed Tiamat and migrated from the Dragon World. Now they worship Ishtar instead of Tiamat.

zones.name: Deserter Encampment
zones.desc: A gathering place for deserters from the Illusion Cavaliers. The despair caused by the destruction of the Illusion Cavaliers caused many to abandon their pride as Daeva and leave the fortress. Now they are harsh and cruel, unrecognizable as the Cavaliers they once were.

zones.name: Forest of Exiles
zones.desc: A forest on the outskirts of the Aullaeu Village. It is home to Holyaul, a former ritualist of the Urugugu tribe, and his followers, who were exiled by Aulamus.

zones.name: Pilgrim's Ridge
zones.desc: This place was called the Pilgrim's Ridge Path because it was a must-stop for those visiting the Zumion Temple and the Ardus Shrine.

zones.name: Pilgrim's Ridge
zones.desc: This place was called the Pilgrim's Ridge Path because it was a must-stop for those visiting the Zumion Temple and the Ardus Shrine.

zones.name: Pilgrim's Ridge
zones.desc: This place was called the Pilgrim's Ridge Path because it was a must-stop for those visiting the Zumion Temple and the Ardus Shrine.

zones.name: Eastern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: The elevated areas of the western highlands and canyon region surrounding Zumion Village. Includes the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Eastern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: The elevated areas of the western highlands and canyon region surrounding Zumion Village. Includes the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Rock Tomb Hill
zones.desc: A hill in the Altamia Highland filled with giant rocks that stand like gravestones. Originally a peaceful place, but after the war and Balaur invasion, this hill became a refuge for Daeva subjected to Balaur experiments. They soon turned into egoless Sura and now wander the hill aimlessly. Later on, with Renegade Daeva also finding refuge here, Rock Tomb Hill has earned a notorious reputation as a dangerous, lawless area.

zones.name: Western Altamia Highland
zones.desc: The elevated areas of the western highlands and canyon region surrounding Zumion Village. Rock Tomb Hill and vast grasslands stretch across the area.

zones.name: Altamia Canyon
zones.desc: A canyon in eastern Verteron. Legend has it that the canyon's intricate and majestic terrain was formed under the influence of Etheria and the Spirit King. The area is monitored closely by the Notos Legion.

zones.name: Altamia Canyon
zones.desc: A canyon in eastern Verteron. Legend has it that the canyon's intricate and majestic terrain was formed under the influence of Etheria and the Spirit King. The area is monitored closely by the Notos Legion.

zones.name: Southern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: A plateau in the highland and canyon region of eastern Verteron, including the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Southern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: A plateau in the highland and canyon region of eastern Verteron, including the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Southern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: A plateau in the highland and canyon region of eastern Verteron, including the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Contaminated Sanctum
zones.desc: An old sanctum where the priests of the Zumion Temple held meetings and prayed until it was destroyed by Meslamtaeda, leaving only a few stepping stones and pillars. Following Meslamtaeda's invasion, the surviving priests sealed Meslamtaeda's Poison Blood in the Purifying Altar, but the seal has since broken, resulting in a dangerous place filled with leaking poison and rampaging Guardite.

zones.name: Destroyed Temple Site
zones.desc: The ground of the ruins of the Altamia Highland. The Zumion Temple and its surroundings, submerged by extreme weather after the Last War, have risen to the surface.

zones.name: Eastern Altamia Highland
zones.desc: The elevated areas of the western highlands and canyon region surrounding Zumion Village. Includes the former site of Zumion Temple and the area contaminated by the poison of Meslamtaeda.

zones.name: Kraka Footpath
zones.desc: A hill named after a legendary Tursin Krall chieftain. Also serving as a path to the Drana Plantation and the Balaur Stronghold, its proximity to these locations means there is a significant risk of encountering Balaur minions.

zones.name: Kraka Footpath
zones.desc: A hill named after a legendary Tursin Krall chieftain. Also serving as a path to the Drana Plantation and the Balaur Stronghold, its proximity to these locations means there is a significant risk of encountering Balaur minions.

zones.name: Romlon's Hideout
zones.desc: Once a small legion that resisted the Balaur, after a particularly brutal defeat, they decided instead to use illusion magic known as the Eye of Enchantment to abduct villagers in pursuit of expanding their influence.

zones.name: Drana Cultivation Area
zones.desc: An area where the Balaur have concentrated their Drana cultivation. A huge Drana condensation root has small Drana trees and devices attached to it, the latter of which are maintained by workers.

zones.name: Drana Plantation
zones.desc: A place where Drana trees are grown and harvested for Drana fruit, managed by individuals who have been modified and enhanced by the Balaur, for whom it is a vital food source. In the past, Drana fruit had to be harvested and processed by hand, but devices have since been developed that allow the extraction of energy directly from the Drana tree itself, before being collected in repositories and fed directly into the Balaur Fortress. At the center of the Drana Plantation looms Ishtar's imposing Power Tower.

zones.name: Drana Processing Area
zones.desc: An area where the Drana harvested from the Drana Cultivation Area is transported or processed. There are a lot of pipelines and repositories that branch out from the power conversion unit.

zones.name: Scarlet Forest
zones.desc: A forest near the Drana Plantation and Nahid Brigade Fortress, with vegetation turned red by the influence of Drana. Escaped Sura and Daeva Wraiths roam between the trees, and Balaur scouts are on regular patrols.

zones.name: Scarlet Forest
zones.desc: A forest near the Drana Plantation and Nahid Brigade Fortress, with vegetation turned red by the influence of Drana. Escaped Sura and Daeva Wraiths roam between the trees, and Balaur scouts are on regular patrols.

zones.name: Scarlet Forest
zones.desc: A forest near the Drana Plantation and Nahid Brigade Fortress, with vegetation turned red by the influence of Drana. Escaped Sura and Daeva Wraiths roam between the trees, and Balaur scouts are on regular patrols.

zones.name: Nahid Brigade Fortress
zones.desc: A Nahid Brigade Fortress under Dragon Lord Ishtar. This place also works as a bio-research station, with facilities for the confinement and study of the Daeva.

zones.name: Garden of the Illusion God
zones.desc: A sanctum built by order of Kaisinel, Spiritmaster and God of Illusion. It was once a beautiful garden where spirits and fairies were bornbut after years left untended during the long war and Kaisinel's disappearance, it became a dangerous place where powerful spirits raged uncontrollably.

zones.name: Pilgrim's Rest
zones.desc: This rest stop was once a shelter for pilgrims visiting Ardus Shrine. Long abandoned, all that remains now are old, broken garden ornaments and stone chairs covered in moss. Although it has lost much of its former majesty, its spring all dried up, it is still a place where Daeva can stay for a while.

zones.name: Abandoned Wind Breeze Office
zones.desc:
An outpost briefly used by the Dawn Legion in the past.
It is currently abandoned and no longer in use.

zones.name: Alert Observation Post
zones.desc: A place where the soldiers of the Zumion Temple gathered during the battle against Meslamtaeda and the Balaur. Now destroyed, the area contains only ruins and the roaming, vengeful spirits of ancient Daeva warriors who died in the war. Notos Legionnaires have gathered to investigate the site and keep watch for any threatening spirits.

zones.name: Ancient Zumion Temple Site
zones.desc: The site of a temple was built to honor Zumion, the first Daeva, when AION was whole and Elysea and Asmodae were one. It was blessed by AION and flourished as a holy place for many years, but fell into ruin after the war.

zones.name: Ancient Zumion Temple Site
zones.desc: The site of a temple was built to honor Zumion, the first Daeva, when AION was whole and Elysea and Asmodae were one. It was blessed by AION and flourished as a holy place for many years, but fell into ruin after the war.

zones.name: Astin Mercenaries Base
zones.desc: A base of the Astin Mercenaries, operating in Tolbas Forest. Though comprised only of humans, they pride themselves on skills that they feel put them on par with any company of Daeva. They are often hired by the Wind Breeze Merchants.

zones.name: Aullaeu Village Border
zones.desc: A temporary campsite built to facilitate the search for Kochi and the other abducted Shugo. It is located on the forest road to Aullaeu Village, and a Dawn legionnaire has been dispatched to scout the area.

zones.name: Beast Hunter Campsite
zones.desc: A rest area for hunters. They hunt the nearby beasts and animals to make a living. Some hunters also trade fresh beast bones and skins here.

zones.name: Cantas Valley Base
zones.desc:
A campsite located in Western Cantas Valley, used by the Dawn Legion for Odyle collection.
Legion members and assisting Shugo merchants reside here.

zones.name: Canyon Campsite
zones.desc: A place of the Notos Legionnaires who have been assigned to monitor and deal with the Corrupted Spirits in the lower part of the Canyon.

zones.name: Coastal Camp
zones.desc: A temporary camp built by the Dawn Legion on the coastal side of Cantas Valley. Dawn legionnaires searching for the Odyle in Cantas Valley built this camp to facilitate investigating the coastal cave.

zones.name: Cohta Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost garrisoned by low-level Balaur troops, serving as a watchtower over the Ellun River Midstream and Verteron Fortress Ruins. Any Shugo or Daeva seen passing by will likely be attacked solely for entertainment.

zones.name: Collapsed Pillar
zones.desc: During the fall of Verteron Fortress, this hideout was a garrison of the Illusion Cavalier Spiritmasters guarding the fortress. They fought fiercely against the Balaur, but were eventually wiped out.

zones.name: Dawn Legion Temporary Outpost
zones.desc:
A temporary outpost once used by the Dawn Legion.
It is currently abandoned and no longer in use.

zones.name: Drana Transport Hub
zones.desc: A base used to assist in transporting goods from the Drana Plantation to the Nahid Brigade Fortress.

zones.name: Eastern Cantas Campsite
zones.desc:
A temporary campsite located in Eastern Cantas Valley.
A place where passing Daeva and merchants stay temporarily.

zones.name: Eastern Shugo Station
zones.desc: A Shugo station located on the border of Tolbas Forest. While the workshop's main role is to craft and supply a variety of goods, its main product is a medicinal herb made from Biruta leaves. Biruta leaves are difficult to work with, so they chose to set up their workshop on the border, where the leaves are readily available.

zones.name: Ellun River Midstream
zones.desc: The middle stretches of the Ellun River, which flows through Verteron. It has a relatively clean environment.

zones.name: Forest Shade Execution Site
zones.desc: The hideout of Selmar and his fellow Daeva, who are driven by delusions to mercilessly attack innocent Daeva. They believe themselves to be the only true Daeva, and all Daeva who pass through to be their enemies.

zones.name: Gargos Thieves Campsite
zones.desc: A band of thieves settled in the Pilgrim's Ridge. Their main targets are the residents of Zumion Village and pilgrims traveling to and from there. In addition to robbing pilgrims of their goods, they are also known to enjoy kidnap and blackmail.

zones.name: Hideout in Front of the Ruins
zones.desc:
A place in the shadow of the collapsed walls of the Verteron Fortress Ruins.
A base once used as a hideout by some of the disbanded Illusion Cavaliers.

zones.name: Highland's End Campsite
zones.desc: A campsite located on the edge of the Southern Altamia Highland, where Notos Legion guards are stationed.

zones.name: Hill of Purification
zones.desc: A small and unassuming campsite built on the highland by clerics trying to clean up Meslamtaeda's poison blood. It is said that some of the surviving priests of Zumion once sealed the poison in a sacred well to prevent it from spreading, knowing it would rot the land if left untreated.

zones.name: Illusion Cavaliers' Campsite
zones.desc: A small campsite inhabited by the Illusion Cavaliers.

zones.name: Kraka Footpath Campsite
zones.desc: A campsite located along the Kraka Footpath. It was established to monitor the path leading from Kraka Footpath into Zumion Village.

zones.name: Laborer's Rest Stop
zones.desc: A place of rest for the Kobolds laboring at the Drana Plantation. Some de-brainwashed Kobolds pretend to be brainwashed in order to try and escape.

zones.name: Maktashan Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost occupied by the Balaur. A site of fierce battles between Balaur and Davea in the past, following their victory, it is now used by the Balaur as an observation post to monitor the Ellun River Marsh.

zones.name: Mantasch Patrol Base
zones.desc: A base for members of the Nahid Brigade patrolling the Kraka Footpath, with a particular focus on the direction of Zumion Village. It also serves as a hub for gathering small amounts of Drana generated in the outskirts and transporting it in bulk to the Nahid Brigade's main force.

zones.name: Marsh Legion Campsite
zones.desc:
A temporary campsite once used by the Dawn Legion while assisting with the restoration of the Barrier Tower.
It is no longer in use, as the Legion is no longer involved in the restoration.

zones.name: Marsh Outpost
zones.desc: A stronghold once used by the Dawn Legion to assist in restoring the Barrier Tower in the Ellun River Marsh. It is no longer used after relations with the Illusion Cavaliers deteriorated.

zones.name: Northern Shugo Station
zones.desc: A small Shugo base located in the northern Tolbas Forest. It stands along the path leading to the Wind Breeze Merchants HQ.

zones.name: Notos Legion Outpost
zones.desc: A place where the Norst Legion and the Daeva are staying to dominate the Drana Plantation.

zones.name: Plateau Hill Base
zones.desc: A base for legionnaire outlaws. They attempted to raid Zumion Village, but were repelled by the Notos Legion and ended up settling here. They make a living looting supplies traveling to and from the highland and raid Notos Legion bases.

zones.name: Poacher's Base
zones.desc: A group that hunts indiscriminately in Tolbas Forest. They do not hesitate to attack other humans or Shugo. Recently, they are trying to cultivate Hallucinogenic Mushrooms, a rare and dangerous plant.

zones.name: Renegade Hideout
zones.desc: A hideout for Daeva who betrayed the Notos Legion. Instead of fighting the Balaur, they now ambush and rob pilgrims on the road. The looted supplies are piled throughout the hideout.

zones.name: Rock Hill Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost built by the Notos Legion after Sura and Karas were witnessed near Zumion Village to ensure no threats come too close.

zones.name: Ruin Exploration Campsite
zones.desc: A campsite for explorers of the ruins along the Ellun River Midstream.

zones.name: Sabga Balaur Campsite
zones.desc: A Balaur Prison Compound located along the Kraka Footpath. Due to its environment being well-suited for incubation of Dratona, it is currently used as a temporary hatching ground.

zones.name: Scarlet Forest Observation Site
zones.desc: A Notos Legion base located near the entrance of the Scarlet Forest. It was established to observe the activity within the Scarlet Forest.

zones.name: Sehna Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost of a chasing unit of Balaur, tasked with killing experiments that escape from the stronghold or run amok.

zones.name: Southern Shugo Station
zones.desc: A farm where the Wind Breeze Merchants raise livestock. The grasses of the Tolbas Forest provide good food for the livestock, but they are often attacked by Aullaeu and wild beasts, so a vigilante group has been formed. However, all of the members are inexperienced in combat.

zones.name: Steep Guard Post
zones.desc: An outpost located on a cliff outside the Dawn Legion Base. It overlooks eastern Cantas.

zones.name: Ugaros Thieves Campsite
zones.desc:
A Thieves Camp led by Ugaros.
They are building their own castle with the wealth they have accumulated by looting nearby trading companies and villagers.

zones.name: Valley Outpost
zones.desc: An outpost built by the Dawn Legion in Cantas Valley. The Dawn Legion is using the Cantas Valley's Odyle Collector to collect the scarce Odyle.

zones.name: Wind Breeze Merchants HQ
zones.desc: Headquarters of the Wind Breeze Merchants, who trade mainly in Verteron. The Shugo of the Wind Breeze Merchants settled here as they set a high value on the Biruta leaves grow in Tolbas Forest.

zones.name: Zumion Village
zones.desc: A village formed by Daeva and humans fleeing the Balaur, and home base of the Notos Legion. It is located within ancient ruins hidden in Altamia Canyon, and was once submerged underwater alongside the Zumion Temple, only to reemerge when the topography of Altamia Canyon changed due to wars between Elyos, Asmodians, and Balaur.

zones.name: Zumion Village
zones.desc: A village formed by Daeva and humans fleeing the Balaur, and home base of the Notos Legion. It is located within ancient ruins hidden in Altamia Canyon, and was once submerged underwater alongside the Zumion Temple, only to reemerge when the topography of Altamia Canyon changed due to wars between Elyos, Asmodians, and Balaur.
